ALL ORDERS DONE

One window frame.
Two useful ideas.

COMPLEMENTARY

Two angles that add up to 90°.

They make a right angle. The complement of x is 90° − x.

SUPPLEMENTARY

Two angles that add up to 180°.

They make a straight line. The supplement of x is 180° − x.
